injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.
Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Coulibaly (hand) is out for Monday's game against the Pistons.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
